race.comment: WIND DREAMER (7) has raced fairly consistently this campaign, especially when sitting on the pace. She is possibly better suited when the track has some give in it. She is one of the many hopes here. MAGNEA (4) resumes here after a poor end to the last prep. She did however begin the last one in good touch so off a nice trial, expecting her to start well. MACHINIST (1) has not won for a long while. However he will show good speed from the low gate so monitor if leading is a good track position on this card. PACIFIC GLAMOUR (2) wears some blinkers this time. This is an easier event to last run. Can get into the placings. HEARTATTACK JACK (6) will sit off the pace from an outside gate but hit the line.
